FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Each planner is a single self-contained HTML file. After you download it, everything — the interface, your data, backups — runs in your browser with no internet connection. There are no servers to reach, no accounts to sign in to, and no features that stop working offline.

No. All Plenivostudio products are sold as one-time purchases. You pay once and keep the file. We will never convert a purchased product into a subscription.

In your own browser on your own device, using IndexedDB with a localStorage fallback. Nothing is transmitted to us or to any third party. If your browser cannot persist data (for example in some private modes or file:// contexts), the planner tells you honestly and offers manual export instead of silently losing your work.

Clearing browser/site data will remove the planner’s stored data. This is why the planner includes a one-click JSON export: keep regular backups in a place you control, and you can restore them any time.

Your single-user license covers you on your own devices. There is no cloud sync, so each copy keeps its own local data. To move data between devices, export a JSON backup on one device and import it on the other.

Recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari on desktop are supported, and mobile browsers work for everyday use. Every product ships with a BROWSER-SUPPORT.md file listing exactly what was tested. We do not claim universal support.

A ZIP archive containing the planner as a single HTML file plus documentation: README, quick-start guide, license, changelog, browser-support matrix and backup instructions.

Through our payment provider’s approved digital delivery. Once checkout is activated, you will get a download link immediately after purchase. Until then, purchasing is disabled and this site clearly says so.

Please read the Refund Policy page in full before buying. In short: because these are downloadable digital products, refunds are limited once the file has been downloaded — with the exceptions described in the policy and as required by applicable consumer law.

No. The budget tracker is a simple informational tool for recording income and expenses. It is not financial advice, and we are not financial advisors.

The license is for a single user. Please do not redistribute or share the file. If someone else wants it, point them to this site so they can get their own licensed copy.

Use the Contact page. Until our contact email is configured, the page will say so plainly rather than pretending to send your message.
